subject: Mobile Development
title: APIs: How Apps Talk to Servers
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on APIs: How Apps Talk to Servers.

hook.text: When you check the weather in an app, the data doesn't live on your phone.

buildup.text: The app sends an API request to a server, which responds with structured data.

discovery.text: APIs use standard formats like JSON so any app can understand the response.

twist.text: Most apps are thin clients — they display data but store almost nothing locally.

climax.text: APIs are the invisible backbone connecting every mobile app to the cloud.

punchline.text: The app asks; the server answers.

quiz.question: What format do most mobile APIs use?
